newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president to visit Mexico.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president to visit Mexico.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam will visit Mexico next week to help expand economic ties between the two countries, Kim's office said on Monday.
It said Kim would leave for New York on Sunday to attend a United Nations meeting on environmental issues, which is due to be attended by leaders from more than 60 countries.
Kim's three-day visit to Mexico will begin on June 26, and he is to be accompanied by leading businessmen. Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo visited South Korea last November.

Kim is also due to hold talks with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, French President Jacques Chirac, Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Hungarian President Arpad Gonce during his stay in New York.
